observations.note: The track reaches its energetic peak here, though the impact is slightly softened by the mix.
The sitar cuts through but shares too much midrange with the rhythm guitars.
The dense metal instrumentation partially masks the sitar during the heaviest passage.
The distorted guitars enter with adequate presence but lack authentic low-end doom weight.
The rhythm tone remains competent but slightly thin for the genre.
The drums establish a steady rhythm that feels a bit stiff and programmed.
Some digital compression haze appears when the arrangement gets dense.
The track ends with a somewhat abrupt fade-out.
The dark scale and heavy instrumentation blend reasonably well to fit the requested doom fusion vibe.

overall_note: The piece merges Indian classical elements with metal instrumentation reasonably well, though the mix and rigid groove hold it back. The energy builds to a decent peak, but the guitars lack the true low-end heaviness expected of doom.
